framework.name: Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science
framework.note: Codes are the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science (adopted 2016, built on the C3 Framework), coded by strand (IS inquiry skills; CV civics; G geography; EC economics and EC.FL financial literacy; H history) and by grade (K-5), band (6-8, with LC/MdC/MC complexity levels) or 9-12; alignment was made by the course author and is not a certification.
